name: Mapbox
label: Mapbox
description: Mapbox official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: geocode, reverse, directions, isochrone, tilequery. Docs: https://docs.mapbox.com/api/search/geocoding/. Mapbox ToS. Geocoding v6 (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/search/geocoding/). Directions v5. Isochrone v1. Tilequery GET /v4/{tileset_id}/tilequery/{lon},{lat}.json (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/tilequery/). Attribution required. Temporary geocodes must not be stored unless permanent=true. Token is access_token query. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Mapbox request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"geocode"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: geocode | reverse | directions | isochrone | tilequery. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'geocode'.

schema.label: contours_minutes
schema.description: Isochrone minutes, comma-separated. Official contours_minutes. Example: 5,10,15.

schema.label: coordinates
schema.description: lng,lat or polyline for directions / isochrone / tilequery. Example: -122.42,37.78;-122.45,37.91.

schema.label: country
schema.description: ISO country filter for geocode. Example: US.

schema.label: geometries
schema.description: directions geometries. EXACT: geojson | polyline | polyline6.

schema.label: language
schema.description: IETF language for geocode / reverse. Example: en.

schema.label: latitude
schema.description: Latitude for reverse. Official latitude. Example: 38.8977.

schema.label: longitude
schema.description: Longitude for reverse. Official longitude. Example: -77.0365.

schema.label: overview
schema.description: directions overview. EXACT: full | simplified | false.

schema.label: profile
schema.description: Routing profile. EXACT: mapbox/driving | mapbox/walking | mapbox/cycling | mapbox/driving-traffic.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Forward-geocode search text for geocode. Official q. Example: 1600 Pennsylvania Ave.

schema.label: tileset
schema.description: Tileset id for tilequery. Example: mapbox.mapbox-streets-v8.

schema.label: types
schema.description: Feature types for geocode / reverse. Example: address,poi.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: geocode, reverse, directions, isochrone, tilequery.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 20. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
